extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Lee County has a $45 monthly premium, a $530 drug deductible and a $6000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent failed to deliver the TPMO disclaimer prior to discussing benefits. The agent collected a Scope of Appointment and scheduled an appointment for 3 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: Priya, you mentioned that you'd 'flag the ones with dental and vision.' While you're allowed to use superlatives, this statement could be seen as misleading. Consider rephrasing to something like 'we have a variety of plans that include dental and vision coverage.'
